'''2009 Match Play Championship Day 2 Reid Smith LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Reid Smith]] at [[2009 Match Play Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|DS2-L-thereisgoodinhim.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Reid E. Smith
* '''Deck name:''' Baloney TIGIH
* '''Username:''' 3MWDJ8
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
